text:
Ravi Patel: Hey team 👋 I’m Ravi — started today as Sr. DevEx. Quick setup/help thread: my personal M1 Mac arrives tomorrow but I’m wondering if I should request a company M2 for local testing (I’ll be working on perf/debugging). Also hitting 403 on a couple of repos (private). Who’s the right person to add me? Also planning to be in SF office Thu if anyone wants to grab lunch. Two quick fun facts: I brewed my own sourdough starter and I once slept in a hammock under the northern lights. Which is the lie?

Liz Park: Welcome Ravi!! :wave: For hardware, ping IT first — they usually approve M2 for infra/devex work. I’ll DM you the hardware request form. For repos, drop your GitHub username here and I’ll route to the right owner. Lunch Thursday — count me in.

IT Support: Hi Ravi — welcome! Please submit the hardware + access form here: https://redwood.internal/it-requests (choose "Laptop Request" & "Repo Access"). For repo 403s, include the repo names and your GitHub handle. If you want faster access, reply with your handle and we’ll start a ticket. Also confirm if you need VPN + yubikey.

Samir Gupta: hey ravi, welcome! If you plan to run model tests locally and want help with CUDA/docker images, I can help set up a small dev VM or container. Lunch Thu sounds great. Also: if you need test datasets, ping me.

DevEx Bot: Note: Ravi Patel added to #devex and assigned buddy: Liz Park. Onboarding checklist updated: Hardware request pending, GitHub access pending.

Maya Chen: stickers & swag: we keep a small stash in the SF office — if you’re in Thu swing by the front desk and ask for swag pack A. Also we do a quick "two truths, one lie" at lunch for new hires — bring your best fib. :smile:

Ravi Patel: Thanks all — GitHub handle is ravi-patel-dev. I need vpn + yubikey. Leaving the two-truths mystery for lunch :grin:. One more tiny thing: I tried cloning and got a failing auth message — if it helps, here’s what I ran:

```
$ git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/internal-playbooks.git
Cloning into 'internal-playbooks'...
Permission denied (publickey).
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

Anyone have a quick fix while IT opens the ticket?

Liz Park: try running `ssh -T git@github.com` and check your ssh keys. If you don’t have one, run:

```
$ ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ravi@redwood.ai"
$ pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub  # then paste into GitHub -> SSH Keys
```

If you want I can jump on a 10-min call to walk through it.

IT Support: Ticket created: #IT-5821 (ravi-patel-dev) — hardware + repo access + yubikey. Expect response in 1 business day, we can do expedited if needed.

Ravi Patel: Amazing, thanks everyone. See you Thu for lunch — bring questions and skepticism about my Iceland story :rocket:
